obligations.subject: e22
obligations.response: Tests shall be made to the front structure within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 2.1. of this UN Regulation.
obligations.ears: The adult headform tests shall be made to the front structure within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 2.1. of this UN Regulation.

obligations.subject: e43
obligations.response: Test shall also be made to the windscreen within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 2.44.
obligations.ears: The adult headform test shall also be made to the windscreen within the boundaries as defined in paragraph 2.44.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the headform impactor shall not contact the windscreen or A-pillar before impacting the bonnet top
obligations.ears: When testing at the rear of the bonnet top, the headform impactor shall not contact the windscreen or A-pillar before impacting the bonnet top.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the headform impactor shall not directly contact the A-pillars, windscreen header and cowl
obligations.exception: except in the case of monitoring testing
obligations.ears: When testing on the windscreen, the headform impactor shall not directly contact the A-pillars, windscreen header and cowl, except in the case of monitoring testing.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor, over the adult areas prescribed by the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together, with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
obligations.ears: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the adult headform impactor, over the adult bonnet top test area and the adult windscreen test area together, with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

obligations.subject: e44
obligations.response: at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area
obligations.ears: Where possible, at least one of these nine tests shall be carried out on the windscreen test area.

obligations.subject: e19
obligations.response: one of these nine tests may be conducted in the cowl monitoring area
obligations.ears: At the discretion of the technical service, one of these nine tests may be conducted in the cowl monitoring area.

obligations.subject: e43
obligations.response: an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used
obligations.ears: For each test on the windscreen, an undamaged and untested windscreen shall be used.

obligations.response: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where these vary throughout the area to be assessed and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
obligations.ears: Where structures vary throughout the area to be assessed, tests shall be to different types of structure and at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

obligations.subject: e44
obligations.response: the number of tests on the windscreen test area may be reduced at the discretion of the Technical Service
obligations.ears: Taking into account any symmetry of the windscreen and relevant structures, the number of tests on the windscreen test area may be reduced at the discretion of the Technical Service.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation
obligations.ears: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart and within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

derived.text: The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be a minimum of 165 mm apart.
The selected measuring points for the adult headform impactor shall be within the adult headform test areas defined in paragraphs 2.1. and 2.44. of this UN Regulation.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: No measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.
obligations.ears: No measuring point shall be located so that the impactor will impact the test area with a glancing blow resulting in a more severe second impact outside the test area.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply
obligations.ears: For the adult headform testing, a longitudinal and transversal impact tolerance of ±10 mm shall apply.
